seoTitle: How to Refresh a TradingView Chart & Reset to Default
metaDescription: Learn how to refresh a stuck TradingView chart, reset the layout to default, remove all indicators quickly, and fix zoom or scale display issues.
intro: When a TradingView chart looks stuck, misaligned, or cluttered with old settings, a quick refresh or reset can solve most display problems. This guide covers how to instantly refresh your chart, reset the layout back to default, and clear indicators fast when things aren't rendering correctly. It's aimed at active traders who need their chart working reliably without a lot of troubleshooting.

steps.heading: Use a quick chart refresh method
steps.body: Reload the page or use TradingView's refresh option to force the chart to reload its current data and settings.

steps.heading: Reset layout to default settings
steps.body: Use the reset layout option to strip back custom settings and return your chart to its original default view.

steps.heading: Remove indicators quickly
steps.body: Clear all indicators from the chart at once if you want to start fresh without manually deleting each one.

steps.heading: Fix zoom and scale issues
steps.body: If your chart looks stretched or compressed, use the auto-scale option to restore normal price and time proportions.

steps.heading: Address a chart that isn't updating properly
steps.body: If price data seems frozen, try refreshing the browser tab or checking your internet connection before assuming there's a platform issue.

faq.question: How do I quickly clear all indicators from a chart?
faq.answer: TradingView typically offers a way to remove all studies at once from the chart settings or right-click menu, saving you from deleting them individually.

faq.question: Why does my chart sometimes stop updating with new price data?
faq.answer: This can happen due to a temporary connection issue or browser glitch, and refreshing the page usually resolves it.

faq.question: What does resetting the layout to default actually change?
faq.answer: It typically removes custom indicators, drawings, and scale adjustments, returning the chart to its original out-of-the-box appearance.

faq.question: Will resetting my chart delete my saved watchlists?
faq.answer: No, resetting the chart layout affects the chart's display settings and doesn't delete your separate watchlists.
